content.story: The Ringmaster has a problem. The famous "Three Ring Spectacular" requires three perfect circus rings — but the prop rings keep slipping out of position! Your patrol has been recruited as the Ring Crew. You must link arms in a perfect circle and pass all three Official Circus Rings (hula hoops) around the entire crew — three times — without breaking the circle. The audience is already seated. The spotlight is on. Don't break the ring!
content.objective: Standing in a linked circle, pass the Official Circus Rings (hula hoops) around the entire Crew 3 complete times without any Crew member releasing their grip. Fastest time wins.
content.description: Your Ring Crew forms a perfect circle, all hands linked. The Official Circus Rings (hula hoops) are spaced out and placed over Crew members' linked arms before the clock starts — no more than one ring may start between the same two Scouts. On the Ringmaster's signal, pass the rings around the inside of the circle — each Crew member stepping through without releasing hands. Three complete circuits. Time stops when the third pass of all 3 rings is complete. The Ringmaster watches for any break in the circle — a broken ring means penalty time.
rules: All patrol members must join the circle — no one sits out
Hands may not be released at any time after the clock starts
The rings must travel around every Crew member in the circle each pass
If hands are released: the pass in progress does not count, re-link and continue (judge records the break)
Rings must travel in the same direction for all 3 passes
The rings are placed before the clock starts — no more than one ring between the same two Scouts at start
content.timeAndScoring: Elapsed time from Ringmaster's signal to completion of 3rd pass. Penalty: +15 seconds per hand-break instance. Officials convert final times to points.
content.setup: Clear a flat open area large enough for the patrol to form a circle. Have hula hoop ready at start. No special setup required.
content.reset: Essentially instant — no physical reset needed. Estimated reset time: under 1 minute.
content.staffing: 1 judge (Ringmaster). Watches for hand breaks, counts passes, times event.
content.notes: Judge must count passes carefully — designate a specific Crew member as the 'counter point' (the third ring passing that Scout = 1 complete pass). Announce this to the patrol before starting. Larger patrols will naturally take longer — officials should account for patrol size when converting to points.
